caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of two main sections: an ornate, flat, metal upper section and a wooden handle. The upper section is primarily yellow in color with gray metal highlights at the tips, featuring three evenly spaced circular cutouts across the top, and an elaborately cut, symmetrical filigree design with floral and foliage motifs below the circles. The circular cutouts are joined by small arches, and the overall upper shape is a wide, inverted U or fork, with the metal curving outward at the prongs. The handle, attached to the base of the metal section, is brown with visible wood grain texture and has a rounded, bulbous end. The object is centrally placed on a plain off-white background, bordered by a single pencil-drawn rectangle.
title: Trivet
